import html # Predefined HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Safe User Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def build_html_page(client_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the user-provided content safely. Parameters ---------- client_input : str The raw string supplied by the user to be inserted into the page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML document with the user content escaped to prevent script injection or other HTML-based attacks. Notes ----- - Uses html.escape to neutralize special characters (<, >, &, ", '). - No exceptions are raised; malformed input is simply escaped. """ # Escape user input to avoid HTML injection (CWE-74). safe_content = html.escape(client_input, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
